# Birmingham City University

> Birmingham City University is a major UK institution with 31,000 students from 100 countries, offering undergraduate and postgraduate programs across six schools plus the Royal Birmingham Conservatoire, with a focus on social responsibility and sustainability.

BCU serves as a comprehensive educational institution in the West Midlands, providing extensive course offerings, campus facilities, and community engagement programs. The university emphasizes its socio-economic impact on the Birmingham region and commitment to net-zero carbon emissions by 2030.

- [Birmingham City University](https://www.bcu.ac.uk): Birmingham City University homepage with course finder, admissions, and student experience info
